summary: Add one offline normalization contract for observed GitHub PR evidence URLs

replay.detail: No claim rewrite, projection, backfill or new binding field.

schema.detail: Pure library function and pinned URL vectors only.

rules.detail: Canonicalizes explicit HTTP/HTTPS github.com PR aliases while rejecting credentials, encoded or dot-segment paths, unsupported authorities/queries and invalid numbers. A URL remains a citation, never work ownership or current-head proof.

compatibility.detail: No existing watch parser or generic evidence attachment behavior changes. Lookup and association callers are separate slices.

manual.detail: No operator action required by this library slice.

recovery.detail: Original evidence remains unchanged; unsupported inputs are explicit and diagnostics never echo submitted credentials.
